mapper.insert: insert into working_log ( working_log_id, working_date, webuser_id, name, role_id, check_in_time, check_out_time, attend_status,memo) values(working_log_seq.nextval,trunc(sysdate),#{webuserId},#{name},#{roleId}, sysdate,null,null,null)
mapper.update: update working_log set check_out_time=sysdate, attend_status=#{attendStatus}, memo=#{memo} where webuser_id = #{webuserId} and working_date=trunc(sysdate) and check_out_time is null
mapper.select: select check_out_time as checkOutTime from working_log where webuser_id = #{webuserId} and trunc(working_date)=trunc(sysdate)-1
select check_in_time as checkInTime from working_log where webuser_id = #{webuserId} and trunc(working_date)=trunc(sysdate)
select check_out_time as checkOutTime from working_log where webuser_id=#{webuserId} and trunc(working_date)=trunc(sysdate)

select working_log_id as workingLogId, trunc(working_date) as workingDate, attend_status as attendStatus, check_in_time as checkInTime, check_out_time as checkOutTime, memo, case when check_in_time is not null and check_out_time is null
and trunc(working_date) < trunc(sysdate) and nvl(attend_status, 'X') != 'CHECK_OUT_LATE' then 1 else 0 end as canCheckoutLate from working_log where webuser_id=#{webuserId} and trunc(working_date) >= to_date(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') and trunc(working_date) < to_date(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
order by trunc(working_date)
mapper.update:
update working_log set check_out_time = #{checkOutTime}, attend_status = 'CHECK_OUT_LATE', memo = case when memo is null or trim(memo) = '' then '퇴근 체크 익일 보정' else memo || chr(10) || '퇴근 체크 익일 보정' end where working_log_id = #{workingLogId} and webuser_id = #{webuserId} and check_in_time is not null and check_out_time is null and nvl(attend_status,'X') != 'CHECK_OUT_LATE'
and trunc(working_date) < trunc(sysdate)
